div.div: Zennin Ossan, Umarekawattara SSS Rank Jinsei ga Kakutei Shita

The virtuous will definitely be rewarded!
This world judges the deeds and good karma of your previous life, and grants you a rank when you are reborn. The benevolent man, even surprising the gods through this, decides to be reborn as the son Alexander of a noble family, and thus starts his SSS-Rank life! Follow Alec's journey as he lives his life as a SSS Rank!!

On their wedding day, he was thrown out by his wife and forced to return to his own home, where he was suddenly ambushed by a glamorous woman searching for a kiss. The moment their lips touched, he felt a torrent of energy surge through his body. When he woke up again, his mind was filled with the memories of thousands of strangers... (Source: Tencent, translated)
